highlights: Food cooked underground using heated stones

attractions.name: Ollantaytambo Archaeological Site
attractions.description: One of the finest surviving examples of Inca urban planning. Massive stone terraces rise along the mountainside with intricately carved temples. A living town where narrow cobbled streets and centuries-old irrigation channels are still used today.

transport_options.description: Scenic rail journey from Ollantaytambo to Machu Picchu Pueblo (and return) with panoramic windows extending onto the ceiling for uninterrupted views of the Sacred Valley, winding rivers, Andean peaks and cloud forests. Journey approximately 1.5 hours. Luggage restricted to 1 backpack up to 8 kg or 1 piece of hand luggage up to 12 kg (max 115 cm total dimensions).
transport_options.recommended_pass: Vistadome Valley Train ticket (VTD #31 outbound, VTD #606 return)

transport_options.description: Scenic rail journey from Ollantaytambo to Machu Picchu Pueblo (Aguas Calientes) operated by PeruRail. Features panoramic windows extending onto the ceiling for uninterrupted views of the Sacred Valley, winding rivers, Andean peaks and cloud forests. Approximately 1.5-hour journey. Luggage limited to 1 backpack up to 8 kg or 1 piece of hand luggage up to 12 kg (max 115 cm total dimensions).
